title: fix(plugin-form): draw customFields members inside explicit sections on the drawer, modal, tabbed, wizard and split arms
body:
Fixes #10254
Clause-②: yes — measured on the built declarations at `49dc4dd3c`. `TabbedFormSchema`, `WizardFormSchema` and `SplitFormSchema` (re-exported from `dist/index.d.ts`) each gain an optional `customFields?: FormField[]` member, the one `DrawerFormSchema` and `ModalFormSchema` already declare. Nothing else on the package face moves: `findCustomFieldMember` and `SectionFieldsContext` are absent from `dist/index.d.ts`. The claim line was amended to `yes` in `5825785976`, and the changeset therefore declares `minor`.

## What changes

With explicit `sections` plus `customFields`, five of the six `object-form` arms built every section member from the object schema alone, so the authored definition was dropped: `drawer`, `modal`, `tabbed`, `wizard` and `split`. The default arm resolves section names against its merged pool and drew the member. Now all six agree.

- `customFieldsMerge.ts`: the override direction's lookup is extracted as `findCustomFieldMember(customFields, name)`, and `mergeCustomFields` (the default arm's merge) now resolves every name through it. Same precedence, one spelling: first member naming the field wins, an empty `customFields` supplies nothing. `withCustomFieldMembers` is retired.
- `sectionFields.ts`: `SectionFieldsContext` gains an optional `customFields`. In `normalizeSectionField`, a bare name that a member names is drawn as that member (shape 3). For a spec `{ field }` entry, the member (a copy) is the BASE the entry's overrides are applied to, in place of `fromObjectSchema`. Over a member base, the widget is re-decided only from the entry's own `type`.
- `DrawerForm.tsx` / `ModalForm.tsx`: the `buildSectionFields` callback passes `customFields: schema.customFields`. Derived (`fieldGroups`) sections go through the same callback, which retires the `withCustomFieldMembers` pre-map. Derived output is unchanged, and #10073's FIELD GROUPS rows pin it.
- `TabbedForm.tsx` / `WizardForm.tsx` / `SplitForm.tsx` (patch round 1): each `buildSectionFields` callback passes `customFields: schema.customFields`. That callback is the only route by which each arm builds section fields. The wizard calls it for the rendered step and again in its final-submit required gate (`missingRequiredByStep`), so both see the member. The mobile auto-stepper hands `WizardForm` runtime `FormField` objects already merged, which `normalizeSectionField` draws verbatim, so nothing is applied twice. The three schema interfaces declare `customFields?: FormField[]`, as the drawer and modal schemas do, because `schema.customFields` does not compile without it.
- `submitTarget.ts` (comment-only): three passages said these three arms neither declare nor render `customFields`, and gave that as the reason not to widen their interfaces. This change makes both false, so the passages are corrected. No code in the file moves.

## Surface

Claim `5825076379`, amended by seat comment `5825490852`, adds `TabbedForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx` and `SplitForm.tsx` at their `buildSectionFields` context. Two things beyond that one line per arm, both forced by the wiring:
- the three optional interface members, since the wiring does not compile without them;
- the `submitTarget.ts` comment corrections, since the change falsifies those sentences.

`submitTarget.ts` (comment-only) joined the claim in `5825785976`.

## Which semantics this unifies (triage note 3)

**Unified:** the base definition a section member starts from. A `customFields` member naming the field supplies the whole definition, in place of the one generated from object metadata. It uses the same lookup and the same precedence as the default arm's merge. A field no member names is generated exactly as before.

**Deliberately not unified (each arm keeps what it had):**
- Section-entry override rules. The default arm copies only `visibleOn` / `colSpan` / `span` from a spec entry. The other five apply `normalizeSectionField`'s full set on top of the base.
- Pool membership. The default arm intersects sections with top-level `fields` and drops a name nothing declares; the other five do not.
- Field order inside a section.

⛔ No default-arm behaviour change: `ObjectForm.tsx` is untouched. The default arm's section order and its dropped section-entry overrides are separate findings, which the seat files at ACCEPT.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **Probe on `main` (`0d39dc6e5`), card schema:** simple `INLINE NOTE`; drawer, modal, tabbed, wizard and split `Note`. After this PR all six read `INLINE NOTE`.
- **A1 (precedence):** one lookup, `findCustomFieldMember`, is shared by `mergeCustomFields` and `normalizeSectionField`. No second merge.
- **A2 (member no section lists):** the default arm does not draw it under explicit sections, and the other five already matched. Pinned as UNNAMED MEMBER on all six arms.
- **A3 (override rules):** kept. A scratch probe through the real `ObjectForm`, re-run on all six arms at `2c6e298ef` (not a pin), reads:
  - Member case. The entry `{ field: 'note', label: 'SECTION LABEL' }` does not restate `required`, and the member (labelled `INLINE NOTE`) declares `required: true`. The default arm renders `INLINE NOTE*`; the other five render `SECTION LABEL*`, whose marker comes from the member.
  - No-member case. The entry `{ field: 'note', label: 'SECTION LABEL', required: true }` does restate `required`. The default arm renders `Note` with no required marker; the other five render `SECTION LABEL*`.

  The label split, and the no-member case's dropped `required`, are the pre-existing override split. No pin authors an override the two rule sets answer differently.
- **Round-1 assumption, falsified:** "each fix is one line". The three schema interfaces did not declare `customFields`, so `schema.customFields` did not type-check. See Surface.
- **A4 (pins):** `__tests__/sectionsCustomFields-10254.test.tsx`, renamed from `drawerModalSectionsCustomFields-10254.test.tsx` now that it covers every arm. It mounts the real `ObjectForm` per `formType`, with five rows on each of the six arms: `simple` is the default-arm control, then `drawer`, `modal`, `tabbed`, `wizard` and `split`. The rows are:
  - LABEL;
  - REQUIRED: `aria-required`, then an empty submit refused with `INLINE NOTE is required` and no `create`, then a filled submit reaching `create`;
  - SPEC ENTRY: a `{ field, colSpan }` entry keeps the member's label, required marker and `textarea` type;
  - UNDECLARED NAME;
  - UNNAMED MEMBER.

  Every schema has ONE section, so the wizard's rendered step is the section under test, and the `drawnFields()` equalities pin that only that step's fields are drawn.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10254-sections-customfields-drawer-modal.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-form': minor`: a public-surface widening (`Clause-②: yes`) takes at least `minor`, and ⛔ never `major`.

**Patch round 2 (`2c6e298ef`):** no source change. The seat's contract review at `49dc4dd3c` passed every code item, and this round moves only the changeset level from `patch` to `minor`. That is frontmatter line 2 only: lines 1 and 3 and the body bytes are unchanged (SHA-256 compared before and after), and the body names no level. Every test below ran at `49dc4dd3c`, which differs from `2c6e298ef` only in that one line. The gates were re-run at `2c6e298ef`.

## Tests (at `49dc4dd3c`)

Every run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`. Verdict lines are quoted.

- Pins: `Tests 30 passed (30)`.
- Reverse proof, wizard leg (round 1): `ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the wizard's wiring line with a marker. On disk the wiring count went 1 → 0 and the marker count to 1; the blob went `b9dfeef7dab8` → `6588dafdd06f`. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 26 passed (30)`. The four are exactly the wizard's LABEL, REQUIRED, SPEC ENTRY and UNDECLARED NAME rows. Restore: blob equals HEAD (`b9dfeef7dab8`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Reverse proof, three-arm leg (round 1): `TabbedForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx` and `SplitForm.tsx` were checked out at `bbe2b1e4b` (wiring count 0 in each), trap-restored. Result: `Tests 12 failed | 18 passed (30)`. The twelve are tabbed, wizard and split × LABEL, REQUIRED, SPEC ENTRY and UNDECLARED NAME. Restore: blobs equal HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.
- Round-0 legs, run at `bbe2b1e4b` under the file's old name:
  - drawer wiring removed: `Tests 5 failed | 25 passed (30)`, the drawer's four member rows plus #10073's drawer FIELD GROUPS row;
  - member-base type guard reverted: `Tests 2 failed | 13 passed (15)`, the drawer and modal SPEC ENTRY rows (`TEXTAREA` vs `INPUT`);
  - the four round-0 sources at `BASE`: `Tests 8 failed | 7 passed (15)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/`: `Test Files 117 passed (117)`, `Tests 1196 passed | 1 skipped (1197)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The 38 suites outside `plugin-form` that name `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` / `TabbedForm` / `WizardForm` / `SplitForm` / `buildSectionFields` / `normalizeSectionField` / `customFields` / `sectionFields` / `submitTarget` / `hasInlineFieldSource`: `Test Files 38 passed (38)`, `Tests 1733 passed (1733)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`): both `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `--listFiles` counts the renamed test once.

## Gates (at `2c6e298ef`, exit codes recorded)

- `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0, `9 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `check-changeset-no-major`: exit 0, `No changeset declares a major bump`.
- `check-changeset-overwrite`: exit 0, `No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted`.
- `check-changeset-fixed`: exit 0, `All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group`.
- `check:new-line-citations` (at `49dc4dd3c`; since then only the changeset's level line changed): `0 new citation(s)`.
- `check:control-bytes`: exit 0, `OK`.
- `check:changeset-claims`: exit 0. It flags five pending changesets that name a touched file: #6237's wizard-step split (`WizardForm.tsx`), #8738, #9884 and #5594 (`sectionFields.ts`), and the simple-form submit-handler one (`submitTarget.ts`). Each paragraph was read and is still true. By symbol, 14 other pending changesets name `TabbedForm` / `WizardForm` / `SplitForm`, and none speaks to `customFields` under `sections` on those arms, or is falsified by this change. The changeset body names all five arms and was not changed in round 2.
- At `49dc4dd3c`: ESLint on every touched file gave 0 errors (the config is not type-aware; per-file warnings are unchanged or fewer), and the governed-surface test answered `NOT GOVERNED`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Default-arm section order and dropped section-entry overrides:** these are separate defects on the default arm, left unchanged here. The seat files them at ACCEPT.
- Two registration descriptions in `index.tsx` quote `ObjectForm.tsx:361` and `ModalForm.tsx:638`. At base `0d39dc6e5`, neither line holds what its description says. There, the quoted `ObjectForm.tsx` line is a comment, and `modalCloseButton` is read further down the file. The quoted `ModalForm.tsx` line is not the `contentLayout` check. This PR does not change `ObjectForm.tsx` or `index.tsx`; the quotes are left as `index.tsx` carries them.
